source.paper_reference: Wang et al., RadioDiff-3D / UrbanRadio3D, IEEE TNSE 2025
source.evidence: local extracted RM_data directory layout and UNIC-Lab/UrbanRadio3D README
source.evidence_boundary: The extracted dataset has per-scene building JSONs and scene_X_Y labels but no wireless parameter file; Tx height and grayscale dB interval are explicit proxies.

data.label_filename_convention: {scene_id}_X{file_x}_Y{file_y}.png; image row=255-file_x, image col=file_y; physics x=file_y, y=file_x

scene.coordinate_convention: building JSON uses bottom-origin [x,y]; UrbanRadio3D label filename X is image-row axis and Y is image-column axis, so physics x=Y and y=X
scene.tx_height_semantics: fixed absolute proxy; archive has no Tx z
scene.tx_height_audit_note: Tx x/y comes from label filenames; configured 20 m is an explicit proxy

png_gray_mapping.method: provisional linear gray/255 to signed pathloss/pathgain dB
png_gray_mapping.status: proxy; conversion table not present in archive

dataset_labels.paper_quantity: signed pathloss/pathgain proxy for archive PNG labels

physics_prior.owr_cd_algorithm_name: OWR-CD (One-Way Recursive Corner Diffraction; canonical UTD wedge)
physics_prior.auto_selection_rule: For each NLoS Rx, use the first blocking building height as the local reference: OWR-CD when Tx/Rx heights are close and both are below half that height; otherwise use OWR-RD.
physics_prior.d1_d2_definition: 3D Euclidean distances using decoded height-map pixels and fixed Tx/Rx heights

visualization.note: Fixed across selected scenes/Tx; archive label and Tx-height assumptions are recorded above.
